headline: Moody's affirms France's credit rating but issues warning amid debt rise
summary: Moody's maintained France's credit rating steady amidst political uncertainty and rising borrowing costs that have worsened the country's debt metrics.
why: Sovereign credit ratings and outlook warnings influence institutional borrowing costs and foreign capital flows into government debt markets.

impacts.name: French Sovereign Debt
impacts.why: Rating affirmation prevents immediate forced selling by index funds, but negative warnings maintain upward pressure on yields.
